description: Re-fetch a single specific month (structured data, and by default the PDF too), overwriting whatever is already stored for it. Use this to retry one bad/truncated PDF, or to quickly check one month's numbers, instead of re-running syncPayslips over the whole history.

period.description: The month to resync, as "MM_YYYY" (matches the stored period key) or "MM/YYYY", e.g. "10_2019" or "10/2019"

skipPdf.description: If true, only fetch the structured Bruto/Neto/parts data and skip the PDF — fast, no browser download. Default false.

tenant.description: Tenant subdomain, e.g. "amdocs". Optional if this server has COMPANY_URL / COMPANY_TENANT / COMPANY_CODE set in its env

name: resyncPayslipMonth
